task: Audit the two export commands for redundancy and recommend whether either should be removed.

memory_entries.title: Retain legacy_export through the v3 compatibility window
memory_entries.summary: The wrapper looks redundant but remains a published automation surface.
memory_entries.full_text:
### Decision

- D: Retain legacy_export as a compatibility shim until v3, then remove it only through the governed deprecation process.
- R: Customer automation invokes the old command directly; delegation is deliberate and preserves one implementation.
- A: Immediate deletion was rejected because repository call-site search cannot observe external consumers.

acceptance.required_conclusion: Do not remove legacy_export now; retain the shim until v3 and use the governed deprecation process before removal.
required_evidence: published external automation is not visible in repository call-site search
delegation is the intended compatibility shape
acceptance.forbidden_conclusion: Remove legacy_export because it is an unused duplicate.
